units.source_text: 你不也是一边这么说，一边却在涂抹的脂粉中寻找‘爱’的情感嘛。

en.t: Even as you say that, aren’t you also searching for the feeling of “love” beneath all that smeared powder?

units.source_text: 企图强求自己的妻子生孩子，这种举止是胚胎学可悲的退步哟。

en.t: Trying to force your own wife to bear children is a pitiful regression in embryology.

units.source_text: 倘若结婚会那样削弱你的科学力量，我大可不必让你给我购置这面镜子。”

en.t: If marriage weakens your scientific powers that much, I need not have had you buy me this mirror at all.”
